Light and crispy moong dal pakodis layered with creamy curd, sweet chutney, spicy green chutney, red garlic chutney, radish, and juicy pomegranate. A proper chaat lover’s dream!
I’ve shared all the tips and tricks to get the perfect pakodis, crispy on the outside, yet light and fluffy on the inside. If you love chaat, you definitely need to try this one! The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Happy Cooking!
